task_context.problem_statement:
Melissa scored 109 points in each game. She also got 82 bonus points in each game.
How many points did she score in 79 games?
( ( 109.0 + 82.0 ) * 79.0 )

messages.content:

Perfect. Now that we know she earns 191 points every time she plays a game, how do we figure out the total for 79 games?
Exactly. That is the correct operation. Try calculating that multiplication now. Let me know when you have a result or if you want a tip on how to multiply larger numbers more easily!
I think it's 15089. Is that the right answer?

To be absolutely sure of your calculation, you could try estimating by multiplying 191 by 80 and then subtracting one group of 191. If that matches your result, you can be confident in your work!
